messages:
Rina (devex): Quick sync: planning py/ts SDK push tomorrow 09:00 PT. Remove legacy sync client + compat shim. Staggered publish and explicit dist-tag + rollback plan.

Evan (sdk): Noted. Last canary had a sign-check warning; I'll rotate signing key in CI preflight.

Sam (release): We need exact dist-tag commands and a grace policy for support. Share commands here.

Evan (sdk): Dist-tag commands:
```
# canary
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@5.0.0 next
# promote
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@5.0.0 latest
# rollback
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@4.9.4 latest
```
For pip, recommend `pip install redwood-sdk==4.9.4` to pin.

Marta (oncall): Rollback triggers: signature verification errors, >1% install failures in 1h, or >5 customer reports in 2h. Alert thresholds: 0.5% first 30m, 1.5% next 90m. I'll prepare a short runbook.

Rina (devex): Stagger: publish py at 09:00, watch 30m, publish ts at 09:40. If sign-check still warns, hold TS publish.

DocsBot: Reminder: add deprecation blurb + migration snippet (sync->async shim) to release notes.

Sam (release): Agreed. Also plan: rotate keys before GA, keep `next` for 24h, promote after 48h if no regressions, remove `legacy-sync` tag after 72h.

Evan (sdk): I'll post CI key-rotation output shortly. If sign-check fails after rotation, we do not change `latest` and run hotfix flow (re-sign and publish 5.0.1).

Marta (oncall): I'll standby for alerts and run a dry-run of the rollback commands now.

Rina (devex): Please react :thumbsup: when acked. We'll proceed unless blocked. Thanks!
